description: 120 MATCH_RECOGNIZE queries over six fixed pattern families; each family contains ten ONE ROW and ten ALL ROWS variants.

  PARTITION BY REGION
  ORDER BY TS, ID
  MEASURES 
    A.ID AS AID,
    B.ID AS BID,
    C.ID AS CID
  AFTER MATCH SKIP PAST LAST ROW
  PATTERN(A Z* B Z* C)
  DEFINE
    A AS A.A1 BETWEEN 100 AND 105 AND A3 LIKE 'a%',
    Z AS Z.TS - A.TS <= 50000,
